Classified standard -- valid, but shorter and less elaborated than instance (1). (3) The evaluation-scope-extension discussion (reasoning-trace quality, tool-selection accuracy, error recovery), citing agility-at-scale.com [[8]] -- verified content-matched, a specific expansion of what "passing" a regression check means.
